verdict.rationale: WorkOS maintains an Auth0 migration guide and a WorkOS CLI migrations tool. The tool exports Auth0 data into a package of users, organizations, memberships, roles and SSO handoff files, and the AuthKit API supports importing users from "a variety of existing sources." However, nothing in the pack shows that password hashes carry over, so the no-forced-reset part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of password hash import that avoids forced resets, documented guides for competitors other than Auth0, independent or hands-on corroboration of a migration.
